title: First Carnatic War (1746-48)
quote: About 930 French beat about 10,000 at St. Thome: small disciplined European infantry + artillery beat far larger Indian cavalry armies

boxes.title: Belligerents & causes
items: Belligerents: ==**British vs French** East India Companies== (APPSC 2018)
European link: direct extension of the **War of Austrian Succession**
Immediate cause: English navy seized French ships → France retaliated

boxes.title: Course of the war
steps: Nawab **Anwaruddin** forbids fighting in his territory; marches against French

boxes.title: Persons → role
head: Person
Role
rows: Sent Anwaruddin as guardian of minor Nawab **Syed Ali**
Killed Syed Ali → ==**Nawab of Arcot (1744)**==; backed English
Led small **French** force at St. Thome
Anwaruddin's son; led Nawab's army at St. Thome

cards.title: Treaty of Aix-la-Chapelle (1748)
lines: Ended War of Austrian Succession + First Carnatic War

boxes.title: Results & significance
items: ==**Naval power**== decided the Anglo-French contest on the **Coromandel** coast
Both sides now eyed Indian politics
First showed Indian rulers' military weakness vs European-trained troops

boxes.title: Exam corner
items: UPPSC 2020/2025: "war ended" and =="English got back Madras"== both correct
⚠ St. Thome = **1746**; Anwaruddin died later at ==**Ambur (1749)**== (Second War)
Madras exchanged for **Louisbourg**, not an Indian territory
